# Eastern Virginia Pediatric Dentistry

> Specialized pediatric dental practice in Norfolk, Virginia offering child-friendly dental care, preventive services, and educational resources for families.

Eastern Virginia Pediatric Dentistry (EVAPD) is a dedicated pediatric dental practice led by Dr. Nathan Shapiro and Dr. Pamela A. Morgan in Norfolk, Virginia. The practice focuses on providing comprehensive dental care for children, including preventive treatments, cavity prevention, and patient education aligned with American Academy of Pediatric Dentistry standards.

## Key Topics

- Pediatric Dentistry
- Cavity Prevention
- Oral Hygiene
- Preventive Dental Care
- Child-Friendly Care
- Fluoride Treatment
- Dental Sealants
- Plaque Removal
- Gum Disease Prevention
- Early Dental Care
- Professional Teeth Cleanings
- Digital X-rays
- Norfolk, Virginia
- Dr. Shapiro and Dr. Morgan

## About EVAPD

- [Home](https://www.evapd.com): Eastern Virginia Pediatric Dentistry homepage with comprehensive pediatric dental services in Norfolk, VA
- [About Our Doctors](https://www.evapd.com/office/about-our-doctors): Bios of Dr. Shapiro and Dr. Morgan, pediatric dentists with specialized training
- [Office Policies & Mission](https://www.evapd.com/office/office-policies-mission): EVAPD office policies, mission statement, hours, and appointment scheduling information
- [Map & Directions](https://www.evapd.com/office/map-directions): Interactive map and directions to EVAPD office location on Hampton Blvd in Norfolk

## Patient Education & Oral Health

- [Your Child's First Visit to the Dentist](https://www.evapd.com/patient/your-childs-first-visit-to-the-dentist): Guide to preparing children for first dental visit following AAPD recommendations
- [Oral Hygiene for Kids](https://www.evapd.com/patient/oral-health/oral-hygiene-for-kids): Guide to oral hygiene for children covering brushing, fluoride, and cavity prevention
- [How to Brush Your Teeth](https://www.evapd.com/patient/oral-health/how-to-brush-your-teeth): Step-by-step brushing technique guide using fluoride toothpaste and disclosing solution
- [How to Floss Your Teeth](https://www.evapd.com/patient/oral-health/how-to-floss-your-teeth): How-to guide for proper flossing technique to prevent gum disease and plaque buildup
- [Tips to Prevent Cavities](https://www.evapd.com/patient/oral-health/tips-to-prevent-cavities): Cavity prevention tips including fluoride treatment and dental sealants for children
- [Toothpaste](https://www.evapd.com/patient/oral-health/toothpaste): Toothpaste guide covering ingredients, fluoride benefits, and ADA Seal of Acceptance

## Dental Services & Treatment

- [Professional Teeth Cleanings](https://www.evapd.com/patient/oral-health/professional-teeth-cleanings): Educational overview of professional teeth cleanings, prophylaxis, and tartar removal
- [Common Problems](https://www.evapd.com/patient/common-problems): Educational guide covering common dental problems including cavities, canker sores, and malocclusion

## Patient Resources

- [Financial & Insurance](https://www.evapd.com/office/financial-insurance): Insurance providers accepted including Aetna, Anthem Complete, Cigna and payment policies

- [FAQ](https://www.evapd.com/patient/faq): Frequently asked questions about pediatric dental care, cavity prevention, and oral health
